name: DnDBeyond
description: DnDBeyond ruleset providing entity schemas and sheet templates.

entities.name: Player Character
entities.description: A playable character with attributes, multiclass levels, spell slots, pact magic, equipment, and features.

entities.name: Spell
entities.description: D&D Beyond spell definition with school, level, casting time, range, components, duration, and rules text.

entities.name: Weapon
entities.description: D&D Beyond simple and martial melee and ranged weapons with damage dice, type, range, and properties.

entities.name: Armor
entities.description: D&D Beyond wearable armor with base AC, dex cap, strength requirements, and stealth penalties.

entities.name: Shield
entities.description: D&D Beyond equippable shields providing armor class bonuses.

entities.name: Item / Adventuring Gear
entities.description: D&D Beyond generic items, adventuring gear, potions, scrolls, rings, and practical wondrous items.

entities.name: Artificer Infusion
entities.description: D&D Beyond Artificer Infusions detailing item prerequisites, target types, attunement, and granted modifiers.

entities.name: Vehicle
entities.description: D&D Beyond vehicles with armor class, hit points, speed, dimensions, crew, cargo, and actions.

entities.name: Vehicle Part / Component
entities.description: D&D Beyond vehicle components including hulls, sails, engines, helms, and weapons.

entities.name: Character Class
entities.description: D&D Beyond character classes with hit dice, spellcasting attributes, subclasses, and class features.

entities.name: Character Race / Species
entities.description: D&D Beyond races and species with speeds, size, ability modifiers, and racial traits.

entities.name: Character Background
entities.description: D&D Beyond character backgrounds with skill proficiencies, tool proficiencies, languages, and features.

entities.name: Feat
entities.description: D&D Beyond feats with prerequisites, benefits, and mechanical rules text.

templates.name: Standard Character Sheet
templates.description: Full interactive D&D Beyond character sheet matching the official 3-column printable layout.

templates.name: Alternative Character Sheet
templates.description: D&D Beyond character sheet with saving throws and skills grouped by ability score.

templates.name: Spellcasting Sheet
templates.description: Dedicated D&D Beyond spellcasting sheet with cantrips, spell slots 1-9, save DC, and attack bonus.

templates.name: Character Details & Backstory
templates.description: D&D Beyond character details sheet with avatar portrait, physical characteristics, backstory, and allies.

templates.name: Spell Description View
templates.description: Full standalone presentation of a spell with level, school, casting time, range, components, duration, and full rules text.

templates.name: Spell Card
templates.description: Compact spell badge with level, school, concentration & ritual tags, casting time, and range.

templates.name: Weapon Description View
templates.description: Full standalone presentation of a weapon with damage dice, type, range, mastery, and properties.

templates.name: Weapon Card
templates.description: Compact weapon badge with damage, range, and properties.

templates.name: Armor Description View

templates.name: Armor Card

templates.name: Shield Description View

templates.name: Shield Card

templates.name: Item Description View

templates.name: Item Card

templates.name: Feat Description View
templates.description: Full standalone presentation of a feat with prerequisites and benefits.

templates.name: Class Description View

templates.name: Race / Species Description View
templates.description: Full standalone presentation of a character species with speed, size, and racial traits.
